# jspassgen

> Quantum-resistant, zero-dependency password and EFF Diceware passphrase generator with Shannon entropy scoring, honeyword decoys, and client-side WebCrypto security.

- URL: https://jspassgen.com
- Documentation: https://jspassgen.com/about
- GitHub: https://github.com/sebastienrousseau/jspassgen
- npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/jspassgen
- Author: Sebastien Rousseau (https://sebastienrousseau.com)
- License: Apache-2.0 / MIT

## Capabilities
- Cryptographic Random Password Generation: 8 to 128 characters, uppercase, lowercase, numbers, symbols, ambiguous exclusion.
- EFF Diceware Passphrase Generation: 3 to 12 words from the curated 7,776-word dictionary (12.92 bits/word).
- Quantum-Resistant Derivation: Argon2id memory-hard KDF + HKDF entropy dispersion.
- Honeywords (Juels-Rivest Decoys): Master key + k decoy credentials for canary breach detection.
- Shannon Entropy Metric: True mathematical entropy calculation H(X) = -sum(p * log2(p)).
- Zero Dependencies: Zero runtime dependencies across core engine.

## CLI Usage
- Instant run: npx jspassgen -l 32 --symbols
- Diceware: npx jspassgen --diceware -w 5 --separator "-"
- Global install: npm install -g jspassgen
